connector.name: PortlandMaps (Unofficial)
connector.registryDescription: Unofficial MCP server for the public PortlandMaps property/permit/zoning API. Not city-affiliated.
connector.summary: Hosted at portlandmaps-mcp.vercel.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package portlandmaps-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the gptnowllc account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PORTLANDMAPS_API_KEY
env.description: PortlandMaps API key. Required for the /api/* tools; without it those endpoints return error payloads.

env.name: PORTLANDMAPS_API_KEY_PARAM
env.description: Query-parameter name to send the API key as. Defaults to 'api_key'.

env.name: PORTLANDMAPS_CACHE_TTL_MS
env.description: In-memory response cache TTL in milliseconds. Defaults to 3600000 (one hour).
